newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania OTC ends firmer on stable market.
newsitem.headline: Romania OTC ends firmer on stable market.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter market (OTC) closed firmer on Monday with investors' focus on oil refineries and cement makers, traders said.

Operators said the market was stable with big players still awaiting more details on new rules for portfolio investments aproved last week by the Romanian government -- but amended according to a government minister.
Traders said they had proceeded without any knowledge of the latest amendments to portfolio investment rules.
Reform Minister Ulm Spineanu said the government had revised the rules by replacing a four percent tax on capital gains with a 1.5 percent tax on each portfoilo deal.
Traders forecast a slight uptrend for Tuesday mainly due to relatively strong buying interest in oil refineries and on some cement makers, which remanined the darlings of the investors.
On Monday 119 stocks prices rose, 87 slipped, while 298 remained flat.

Unofficial indices VAB-RA, computed by Vanguard securities, and BIG-OTC, compiled by the BIG brokerage house, rose to 3,664.6 and 2,678.92 points respectively, gaining 0.9 percent and 9.74 percent. Both indices are computed based on average prices of OTC listings.
Strong buying mood in oil refinery Petrobrazi lifted its closing price by 1,000 lei to 23,500, while another refinery, Arpechim, gained 2,000 lei to 28,000.
Cement maker Romcim ended 2,000 lei firmer at 69,000, while Moldocim, another cement maker, finished flat at 29,500 lei.
Overall turnover rose on Monday to 12.4 billion lei from 8.6 billion on Friday, with over than 12 million shares traded.
The VAB-RA index is displayed on VANGUARD.
